description: This PHP source file defines the AWS IoTEventsClient class, which extends AwsClient and provides methods to interact with AWS IoT Events service API, including creating, deleting, describing, listing, updating, and managing alarm models, detector models, inputs, and related resources.

classes.name: IoTEventsClient
classes.description: Client class to interact with AWS IoT Events service API, providing methods for managing alarm models, detector models, inputs, and related operations.

methods.name: createAlarmModel
methods.description: Creates a new alarm model in AWS IoT Events service.

methods.name: describeAlarmModel
methods.description: Retrieves details of an alarm model.

methods.name: describeDetectorModel
methods.description: Retrieves details of a detector model.

methods.name: describeDetectorModelAnalysis
methods.description: Describes the analysis of a detector model.

methods.name: getDetectorModelAnalysisResults
methods.description: Gets results of detector model analysis.

methods.name: listAlarmModelVersions
methods.description: Lists versions of an alarm model.

methods.name: listDetectorModelVersions
methods.description: Lists versions of a detector model.

methods.name: listTagsForResource
methods.description: Lists all tags for a resource.

methods.name: startDetectorModelAnalysis
methods.description: Starts analysis of a detector model.
